translations.web: Your children hurry. Your destroyers and those who devastated you will leave you.
translations.bsb: Your builders hasten back; your destroyers and wreckers depart from you.
translations.kjv: Thy children shall make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth
translations.asv: Thy children make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth from thee.
